text.p: - Nearly 1,000 Kurds protested against "Turkish occupation plans" at the Turkish Embassy in Berne last Saturday.
- The Swiss People's Party voted 181 to 8 in favour of the referendum to make it tougher for illegal immigrants to enter and stay in Switzerland.
- Zellweger Luwa is acquiring British firm Neotronics Technology for 44 million Swiss francs.
- Attisholz expects a loss of between 21 and 25 million Swiss francs for the 1995-96 fiscal year due to falling prices.
- Von Roll's first half net profit fell to 9 million Swiss francs from 12 million the year before.
- The Swiss Commodities Futures and Options Association's 17th meeting in Buergenstock focused mainly on the theme of introducing the Euro.
